Class OfferCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.OfferCard
public class OfferCard extends Object
Represents a single Offer Card on the game board.

Each card defines the rules for a specific slot during the offer phase, including the number of cards a player can draw from the upper and lower rows, and any immediate food bonuses. It also tracks which player's totem is currently placed on it.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferCard

      public OfferCard(char letterId, int numUp, int numDown, int foodBonus, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new OfferCard with the specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      letterId - the identifier of the card (A to G, depending on the number of players)
      numUp - the number of cards the player can pick from the upper row
      numDown - the number of cards the player can pick from the lower row
      foodBonus - the amount of food awarded immediately upon choosing this card (only for A)
      numPlayers - the number of players in the current game
